Package nl.pim16aap2.util.logging

@NullMarked package nl.pim16aap2.util.logging
This package contains a set of utilities the for logging framework. For example the Log4J2Configurator class in this package, which allows you to configure the logging framework to your needs, such as setting the log level, the log file, or the log format.
